teaching_language: English (applicants must prove English proficiency and submit documents and the research proposal in English; the guideline names no separate teaching language)

milestones.label: Applications open for MIS 2026/2027 (reported by Universiti Sains Malaysia and MastersPortal, not confirmed by the funder)
milestones.source_text: Reported by a Universiti Sains Malaysia school page and MastersPortal; the ministry's own page only says the round is closed. One listing gives 6 March instead.

milestones.label: Application deadline (reported by Universiti Sains Malaysia, UNITEN and MastersPortal, not confirmed by the funder), MIS 2026/2027
milestones.source_text: Three unofficial sources (a Malaysian university school page, a second Malaysian university and a scholarship portal) give 3 April 2026. The official MOHE portal states that applications for 2026/2027 are closed.

milestones.label: Status-checking period on the MOHE portal for 2026/2027 applicants
milestones.source_text: The official MOHE MIS portal says applicants can check their status from 8 October to 31 December 2026.
